components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Nebula Violet fill, white text, 0.75rem radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: hsl(263 70% 58%); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Hero Gradient Button
components.description: The one gradient CTA per page. CTA gradient fill (darker stops; white text >= 4.5:1 at every point), aurora shadow, arrow slides on hover.
components.html: Start chatting free
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: linear-gradient(120deg, hsl(263 70% 50%), hsl(316 72% 46%) 55%, hsl(349 80% 46%)); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.25); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-hero svg { transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.40); } .ds-btn-hero:hover svg { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary. Hairline stroke, Mist fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); background: transparent; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Token-based field (simple-input). Violet focus ring, no border shift.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); background: #fff; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Marquee and filter rail pill. Hover lifts the border toward violet.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90% / 0.6); background: #fff; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.4); color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status pill. Default violet; secondary Mist.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: hsl(263 70% 58%); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge--secondary { background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); color: hsl(240 5.9% 10%); }

components.name: Chat Bubbles
components.description: The signature object. AI bubble left with cut top-left corner; user bubble right in Nebula Violet with cut top-right corner; typing indicator.
components.html:
The nav console flickers. "Course locked. Where to, captain?"
Somewhere with a decent bar.
components.css: .ds-chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: 360px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-bubble { width: fit-content; max-width: 85%; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 1rem; } .ds-bubble--ai { background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); border-top-left-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-bubble--user { margin-left: auto; background: hsl(263 70% 58%); color: #fff; border-top-right-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-typing { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-typing span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; opacity: .7; animation: ds-bounce 1s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-typing span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .15s; } .ds-typing span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; } @keyframes ds-bounce { 0%,60%,100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: .6; } 30% { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 1; } }

components.css: .ds-char { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 220px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90% / 0.5); background: #fff; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 300ms; } .ds-char:hover { border-color: hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.3); } .ds-char__art { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3/4; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(263 70% 58%), hsl(316 72% 58%)); overflow: hidden; } .ds-char__initial { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(255 255 255 / .9); transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-char:hover .ds-char__initial { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-char__fade { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 33%; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgb(0 0 0 / .6), transparent); } .ds-char__meta { position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: 8px; display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-char__pill { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / .5); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); color: rgb(255 255 255 / .9); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-char__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; } .ds-char__name { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-char:hover .ds-char__name { color: hsl(263 70% 58%); } .ds-char__by, .ds-char__tag { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-char__tag { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-char__cat { margin-top: 8px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.1); color: hsl(263 70% 45%); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90% / 0.4); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: hsl(263 70% 58%); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; background: linear-gradient(100deg, hsl(263 70% 58%), hsl(316 72% 58%) 55%, hsl(349 89% 66%)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav a { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(263 70% 58%); border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 420px; padding: 56px 32px; border-radius: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90% / 0.5); text-align: center; background: radial-gradient(42rem 28rem at 18% 12%, hsl(263 70% 58% / 0.22), transparent 68%), radial-gradient(38rem 26rem at 82% 6%, hsl(316 72% 58% / 0.16), transparent 66%), radial-gradient(30rem 22rem at 62% 88%, hsl(32 95% 58% / 0.10), transparent 70%), #fff; } .ds-stage__grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(hsl(240 10% 3.9% / 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(60rem 40rem at 50% -10%, black, transparent); mask-image: radial-gradient(60rem 40rem at 50% -10%, black, transparent); } .ds-stage__eyebrow { position: relative; margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-stage__title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-stage__grad { background: linear-gradient(100deg, hsl(263 70% 58%), hsl(316 72% 58%) 55%, hsl(349 89% 66%)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
InfiniStar is a theater for characters. The canvas is quiet and nearly monochrome, white paper by day and near-black night by default in the dark theme, so that the only saturated thing on screen is the light the characters stand in. That light is an aurora: Nebula Violet fading through Aurora Fuchsia into Ember Pink, with a faint Solar Amber warmth at the far edge. It appears as a soft radial backdrop behind hero and call-to-action sections, as a gradient fill on the brand mark and the one hero button, and as gradient-clipped text on the single phrase in a headline that matters most. Everywhere else the palette is neutral, and the aurora is felt only as a violet tint on a hover border or a focus ring.

The performer on this stage is the chat bubble. Even the marketing pages sell the product by showing a conversation, not a screenshot: a frosted-glass card, a character header, an AI bubble on the left with a small cut top-left corner, a user bubble in Nebula Violet on the right with a cut top-right corner, and a three-dot typing indicator. Density is relaxed and mobile-first. Bricolage Grotesque gives headings a confident, slightly quirky voice; Inter keeps everything readable at small sizes for long reading and typing sessions on a phone.

The system rejects generic-AI clutter it once had. Product surfaces (dashboard, cards, forms) are flat and quiet; glow belongs to hero objects and to hover, never to layout.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral zinc canvas in both themes; saturation reserved for the aurora and the primary action
One violet family (263°) as primary, ring, user bubble, and brand gradient start
Aurora backdrop + film grain + dot grid as the marketing stage; never on product screens
Chat bubble as the signature object, with asymmetric corners that show who is speaking
Bricolage Grotesque display type at tight tracking; Inter body at generous leading
Frosted-glass header and cards (80% background, 20px blur) as the one material with depth
Pill chips and badges; 0.75rem radius for controls; 1.5rem to 2.5rem for marketing panels

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Nebula Violet is the only saturated solid on a product screen. If a second saturated fill appears, it is an error unless it is a category accent on a character card tag.

rules.name: The Aurora Is Scenery Rule
rules.body: Fuchsia, pink and amber exist only inside gradients and radial backdrops. They are never text, never a border, never a button.

rules.name: The Alpha Border Rule
rules.body: Borders are the hairline token at 40 to 60% alpha (border-border/50) on marketing and glass surfaces, full strength on form controls. Hover raises a border to primary/30 or primary/40; it never changes the fill.

rules.name: The Heading Font Is Heading Only Rule
rules.body: Bricolage appears on h1 to h6, card and step titles, the brand wordmark, and stat numerals. It never sets a paragraph, a button, or an input.

rules.name: The One Gradient Phrase Rule
rules.body: Gradient-clipped text is limited to one phrase per page, plus the wordmark and step numerals. A second gradient headline on the same screen is one too many.

rules.name: The Glow Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Glow appears on at most one object per viewport, and that object is a hero or the primary action. Cards, inputs, nav, and lists never glow.

rules.name: The Glass Has an Edge Rule
rules.body: Every frosted-glass surface carries a border-border/60 hairline so it reads as a pane, not a smear.

dos: Do route every color through the semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border/50); the same component must look right in both themes without a dark: override.
Do keep Nebula Violet as the only saturated solid on product screens, and use it for the primary action, the user's bubble, and focus.
Do preserve the asymmetric bubble corners (rounded-2xl with rounded-tl-md for AI, rounded-tr-md for the user) wherever a message renders.
Do set headings in Bricolage with tracking-tight and [text-wrap:balance], body in Inter with relaxed leading, and never load a webfont over the network.
Do use hairlines at 50% alpha and tonal layers for structure; escalate to a violet 30% border on hover.
Do confine the aurora backdrop, grain, dot grid, and glow shadows to marketing hero and CTA sections.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: marquees stop and wrap, theme transitions drop to 0ms, entrance animations may be removed.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand hue. Blue, teal, green and rose fills are off-system except semantic states (green live dot, red destructive and 18+).
Don't put glow, blurred blooms, or shadow-xl on cards, inputs, lists, or navigation. Glow is for one hero object per viewport.
Don't use gradient text on more than one phrase per page, and never on body copy, labels, or buttons.
Don't hardcode gray-*, violet-*, sky-*, or blue-* utilities in new components; the legacy Input primitive and the gradient button variant are the anti-reference.
Don't set body text, buttons, or inputs in Bricolage Grotesque.
Don't add sparkle-icon pill badges as decoration; the hero eyebrow pill is the single sanctioned use.
